resolved_bugs.description: backup.ts fallback settings object could drift from DEFAULT_SETTINGS.
resolved_bugs.fix: Use { ...DEFAULT_SETTINGS } instead of a hand-written literal.

resolved_bugs.description: Static widget imports could crash app startup when the native module is absent.

resolved_bugs.description: tts.ts compared voice.quality against string literals that may not match the SDK type.

resolved_bugs.description: Stray empty ChipRow JSX in WordFormScreen.
resolved_bugs.fix: Removed the block and the unused import.

resolved_bugs.description: src/speech/useSpeechCheck.ts imported 'expo-speech-recognition' and app.json registered its config plugin, but the package was missing from package.json dependencies, so tsc would fail with TS2307 and expo prebuild could not resolve the plugin.
resolved_bugs.fix: Added "expo-speech-recognition": "~58.0.0" to dependencies (npm registry latest is 58.0.0). Verified the name/version exists via https://registry.npmjs.org/expo-speech-recognition/latest; install not yet run in this session.

resolved_bugs.description: Risk that 'expo-file-system/legacy' no longer exists in SDK 58.
resolved_bugs.fix: Checked the installed package (expo-file-system 58.0.10): package.json exports './legacy', and build/legacy/index.d.ts re-exports cacheDirectory, documentDirectory, writeAsStringAsync, EncodingType. tsconfig uses moduleResolution bundler, so the subpath resolves.

resolved_bugs.description: tsconfig.json used baseUrl, which TypeScript 6 reports as TS5101 error (deprecated in TS 7).
resolved_bugs.fix: Removed baseUrl and the unused "@/*" paths (grep showed no @/ imports); tsc now exits 0.

resolved_bugs.description: All 4 Jest suites failed to run: Cannot find module babel-preset-expo (babel.config.js presets it, but it was not installed).
resolved_bugs.fix: npx expo install babel-preset-expo (SDK-compatible version added to devDependencies).

resolved_bugs.description: src/db/reviews.ts called db.execAsync(sql, [params]) but expo-sqlite execAsync takes exactly one argument (TS2554).
resolved_bugs.fix: Switched that statement to db.runAsync(sql, nowIso()).

resolved_bugs.description: app.json contained newArchEnabled, rejected by the Expo SDK 58 config schema (expo-doctor failure).
resolved_bugs.fix: Removed the field; the New Architecture is the only architecture in SDK 58.

resolved_bugs.description: Jest globals (describe/it/expect) were unresolved by tsc under TypeScript 6, because @types/jest was not picked up for files under __tests__.
resolved_bugs.fix: Added "types": ["jest"] to tsconfig compilerOptions (explicit ambient types, not a suppression).

resolved_bugs.description: Placement screen could show a question with no answer options and no way to continue: it allowed the typing kind (options: null) while rendering option buttons only.
resolved_bugs.fix: Moved placement question building to src/quiz/placement.ts, which only accepts multiple-choice questions with at least two options; added a "Bỏ qua câu này" fallback and tests.

resolved_bugs.description: Groq produced a phrase but the dictionary step rejected it, so the word could not be saved; the dictionary also had call limits and no phrase support.
resolved_bugs.fix: Removed src/dict/*, dictionary_cache and every validation branch that required a dictionary hit. Both creation modes now go through the same Groq-backed schema and duplicate check.

resolved_bugs.description: A learned word could pay coins again after delete-and-re-add or in another mode, and duplicate taps could create two coin movements.
resolved_bugs.fix: term_key history plus unique reward index, source_id on every ledger row, reward/penalty inside the review transaction, balance clipped at zero.

resolved_bugs.description: 60-second mode ended after the small question batch was answered, so it could finish in a few seconds.
resolved_bugs.fix: continueRush appends a new shuffled batch while time remains; the end overlay now distinguishes "time up" from "no more questions".

resolved_bugs.description: Vocabulary audio was muted by the Ring/Silent switch and seemed quiet even at maximum media volume.
resolved_bugs.fix: Speech temporarily upgrades the audio session to playback (playsInSilentMode true), restores media mode afterwards and ducks background music.

resolved_bugs.description: Pronunciation check could sit on "Đang nghe…" forever when iOS ended the task without a final result, and a sample word still playing blocked the microphone.
resolved_bugs.fix: Stop TTS before starting recognition, finalize from the last interim transcript on end/stop, and stop the task after 9 s with an explicit no-speech message.
